links.comparator_used: Higher temperature settings (three temperature settings compared, including default/higher values)
links.outcome: Inter-rating reliability and accuracy of LLM-generated NGASR suicide risk ratings
links.effect: Zero-shot prompting at temperature 0 yielded perfect inter-rating reliability (α=1.00, 95% CI: [1-1] for high & very high risk); lower temperatures consistently improved reliability and accuracy.
links.quote: Lower temperatures consistently improved reliability and accuracy.

links.outcome: Human-AI agreement for very high suicide risk and classification performance
links.tradeoff: Critical clinical items showed poor validity; agreement was only moderate, limiting use to initial screening rather than detailed assessment.
links.quote: Zero-shot prompting at temperature 0 yielded perfect inter-rating reliability (α=1.00, 95% CI: [1-1] for high & very high risk), while few-shot prompting showed best human-AI agreement for very high risk (α=0.78, 95% CI: [0.67-0.89]) and strongest classification performance (balanced accuracy 0.54-0.71).

design_hint: LLM configuration control (temperature and prompting style)
